step1_analysis.description: A passive RC filter network used for supply decoupling and control voltage filtering in a fractional-N synthesizer. It provides low-pass filtering to suppress high-frequency noise on the supply and control lines.

paper_reference.title: A 700-kHz Bandwidth Fractional Synthesizer With Spurs Compensation and Linearization Techniques for WCDMA Applications

bandwidth.description: -3dB cutoff frequency of the RC low-pass filter

sky130_expected.calculation: f_3dB = 1 / (2 * pi * R1 * C1). Using R1=22.7kOhm and C1=10pF gives approximately 700 kHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Targeting the loop bandwidth specified in the paper for the synthesizer.

settling_time.description: Time required for the filter output to settle to 90% of its final value after a step input

sky130_expected.calculation: t_settle ≈ 2.3 * R * C for 90% settling of a first-order RC circuit. 2.3 * 22.7k * 10p ≈ 522 ns. The paper's 7 us is for the entire PLL closed-loop settling.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The sub-block settling time is much faster than the full PLL loop settling time.

power_consumption.description: Static DC power dissipation of the filter network

sky130_expected.calculation: P = (VDD - Vcontr)^2 / Rx. With VDD=1.8V, Vcontr=0.9V, Rx=22.7kOhm, P = (0.9)^2 / 22.7k = 35.6 uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The paper's 28 mW is for the entire synthesizer. The passive filter only dissipates power due to DC bias differences across its resistors.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure the -3dB bandwidth, step response settling time, and DC power dissipation of the passive RC filter network.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Passive RC Filter Testbench
.param R1_val=22.7k Rx_val=22.7k C0_val=10p C1_val=10p Cx_val=10p

* DUT
R1 VDD N1 {R1_val}
Rx VDD Vcontr {Rx_val}
C0 VDD 0 {C0_val}
C1 N1 0 {C1_val}
Cx Vcontr 0 {Cx_val}

* Sources
* VDD includes a DC operating point, an AC source for bandwidth, and a small step for transient settling
VVDD VDD 0 dc 1.8 ac 1 pulse(1.8 1.9 1n 1n 1n 10u 20u)
VVCONTR Vcontr 0 dc 0.9

.control
  * 1. DC Operating Point & Power
  op
  * Power dissipated in the passive network
  let pwr = -i(VVDD)*1.8 - i(VVCONTR)*0.9
  print pwr
  
  * 2. AC Analysis for Bandwidth
  ac dec 100 1k 100Meg
  let gain_db = vdb(N1)
  meas ac bw_3db when gain_db=-3 fall=1
  
  * 3. Transient Analysis for Settling Time
  tran 10n 5u
  * Measure time to reach 90% of the 0.1V step (1.8V + 0.09V = 1.89V)
  meas tran t_settle trig v(VDD) val=1.85 rise=1 targ v(N1) val=1.89 rise=1
  
  quit
.endc
.end
